dedupe_keys.name: optimal design of filterless horseshoe networks supporting point to multipoint transceivers

description: Napoli, Antonio and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. The implemented integer-linear optimisation represents metro-aggregation horseshoe networks carrying digital subcarrier-multiplexed point-to-multipoint traffic. It selects a filterless network configuration to reduce amplifier requirements while satisfying end-to-end transmission performance. Coverage is the published network-design experiment; topology size and algorithm implementation language are not given in the short description. The exact registered companion describes the same ILP family with receiver input-power, hub subcarrier-power-difference and minimum-OSNR constraints. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements.
